visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a static shot of a computer component receipt totaling over 63,000 TWD, quickly cutting to a interior car shot where a woman is filming a man in the driver's seat whose face is obscured by a bear emoji. (2) The scene shifts to the entrance of a 'CoolPC' (原價屋) retail store with glass doors and promotional posters, then cuts to the interior showing aisles filled with computer hardware boxes like 'AOPEN' and 'CENTURY II'. (3) A man in a blue promotional vest is seen in a medium shot inside the store looking at a monitor, followed by a wide shot of the man with the bear emoji interacting with store staff. (4) Close-up shots follow of a white computer case with glass panels and glowing fans; a hand points at the 'Caution' sticker on the glass. (5) A black screen with large white text transitions the scene back to the car interior, where the woman shows a credit card and then the finalized receipt to the camera. (6) The woman, with long dark hair and a white sweater, appears in a medium shot inside the car holding a small, slim promotional stick of 'Hsinyen Lutein Jelly'. (7) A high-quality graphic overlay appears showing the 'Ultra-micromization' technology with icons of fruit, a microscope, and molecular structures. (8) The woman is shown in a close-up eating the jelly from the stick while smiling, followed by a screen displaying a collection of health product boxes under the title 'Hsinyen Goddess Festival'. (9) The video returns to the car where heart and emoji overlays appear over the driver as he turns the steering wheel. (10) A final text-heavy screen displays a countdown and a photo of the woman in a festive red outfit.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main female creator, 1 male driver/husband, and approximately 3 store staff/customers in the background.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young woman with long, straight dark hair wearing a white casual sweatshirt. The male character wears a light-colored sweatshirt and jeans, though his face is consistently masked by a digital bear emoji.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The store background is a typical electronics retailer with shelves stacked with colorful boxes (motherboards, GPUs, power supplies). The car interior is modern with leather seats and street lights visible through the window. Promotional segments use clean, white graphic backgrounds.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-tempo acoustic guitar and light percussion BGM starts. A young female voice narrates with a high-pitched, cheerful tone. (2) A subtle 'ding' sound effect plays as the scene transitions to the computer store. Background ambience includes soft room reverb and distant chatter. (3) A sharp 'whoosh' transition SFX marks the switch to the product showcase. The narration speed increases slightly to cover technical details. (4) A 'pop' bubble sound effect occurs when emojis appear on screen. The male speaker's voice is heard briefly, exhibiting a laughing, skeptical tone with moderate conversational loudness. (5) The music swells during the promotional 'Goddess Festival' graphic, and the narrator's tone becomes more professional and persuasive. (6) A final record scratch or light cartoon 'laugh' SFX plays at the very end as the BGM fades.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Story -> Product Integration -> Promotion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a relatable personal story (surprising a husband with an expensive gift) to build viewer engagement and trust before pivoting into a commercial endorsement for Hsinyen health supplements, specifically lutein jelly.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of products, detailed explanation of technological features, and specific promotional dates and discounts.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video blends organic vlog content with professional marketing graphics to soften the commercial impact.
